title: Manitowoc showcases complete lifting solutions at bauma CHINA 2026
summary: Manitowoc will exhibit under the theme “Complete Lifting Solutions.
body_markdown:
## Lifecycle support solutions take center stage


Aftermarket support for cranes is an increasingly important aspect of ownership, as construction companies prioritize operational efficiency, greener jobsites, and lifecycle value. Expectations continue to grow beyond crane performance, and fleet owners and contractors increasingly rely on responsive service, available parts, operational support, and lifecycle solutions to maximize uptime and efficiency.


On the booth will be a host of products and technologies dedicated to aftermarket support and helping customers maximize return on investment for their crane. These include[Potain Power Solutions](https://www.manitowoc.com/company/news/manitowoc-launches-potain-power-solutions-energy-systems-emerging-markets) , which bring greater efficiency, consistency, and environmental care to tower crane operations. There will also be a range of digital and intelligent jobsite technologies, including the new[ECS (Ergo Control System)](https://www.manitowoc.com/company/news/potain-launches-ecs-new-era-smart-connected-tower-crane-control-emerging-markets) , plus anti-collision technologies, cameras, and monitoring systems. All reflect Manitowoc's continued focus on operational efficiency and intelligent equipment management.


Elsewhere, the newly developed Potain K1000A mast will be shown – a 3.45 m x 3.45 m heavy-duty mast that’s perfect for the popular[Potain MCT 2205](https://www.manitowoc.com/potain/top-slewing-cranes-asia/mct-2205-n80) and will also suit one of the upcoming high-capacity cranes to be announced at bauma China. It works as an alternative to the 4 m x 4 m mast sections currently offered on heavy-duty tower cranes from Potain.


Through new crane innovations, intelligent technologies, energy solutions, and comprehensive aftermarket support, Manitowoc's presence at bauma CHINA 2026 will demonstrate how the Company continues to evolve as a trusted partner across the entire lifting lifecycle. Visitors to the booth will gain insight into the future of lifting and the solutions designed to help them operate more safely, efficiently, and profitably.


Manitowoc is located at Booth A.38 at[bauma CHINA](https://bauma-china.com/en/?_gl=1*7jprvb*_up*MQ..*_gs*MQ..&gclid=CjwKCAjw_KjVBhAHEiwAnC0N9E1uvc-BSL8ShDmGMW6VIzetPuwT7vpFv7CVz1GbWaG_3yi0_qphhxoC-6kQAvD_BwE&gbraid=0AAAAA9-qZ9ijQAyhz5RQfljKS4gAwtmnO) 2026, which takes place from November 24-27, 2026 at the Shanghai New International Expo Center.
